correctness.rationale: The analytic jet-rank lemma yields λ_min~T^(2q) when derivatives through order q first span the m-dimensional coefficient space; the lower bound uses fixed-degree polynomial norm equivalence and a uniform Taylor remainder, the upper bound uses a nullvector for preceding rows. For w=−ia/(2π), derivatives are u^k k!∑_j w^j n^(2k−3j)/(j!(k−2j)!). Exact seven-mode jet determinant factor 597196800w³(57600w⁴−47320w²−22247) has one positive physical r=−w² root; a six-row minor remains nonzero for pure imaginary w≠0 and the order-seven replacement determinant is nonzero there. Thus first spanning jet q=7 at resonance and q=6 otherwise. Exact polynomial identities were independently checked at 11 integer values of w exceeding degree ≤9, plus analytic argument for all small real T. At a=0 opposite modes coincide; positive-T independence follows from analytic full jet rank.
